recovery.warning1: Store it somewhere private and durable.

recovery.warning3: It will not be shown again. You can rotate it later in Settings.
recovery.ack: I've saved the key. I understand it cannot be recovered later.

server.usageEmptyDesc: Requests through the local proxy will show up here.
integration.noChanges: No changes — the current file already matches.
integration.backupNote: Existing files are backed up automatically before writing.
integration.plaintextNote: This mode writes the API key into the tool’s local configuration in plaintext. The tool and anyone with access to that file can read it.
integration.helperNote: This mode lets the tool request the key from AIPass while the vault is unlocked. The tool receives the plaintext key at runtime.
integration.envNote: This mode supplies credentials through the tool’s environment. The tool can read the plaintext credential at runtime.
integration.officialNote: This mode uses the tool’s native sign-in credentials, which are stored and managed by that tool.
integration.proxyNote: This configuration writes a local proxy token. The tool sends requests through AIPass; the provider key stays in the vault.
settings.saveFailed: Could not save. Your changes are still here; correct the problem and try again.
integration.protocolMismatch: This agent does not support the selected route's API protocol.
integration.defaultModelRequired: Set a default model on at least one credential in this route.

settings.title: Settings
settings.serverResponseWait: Active requests wait for the provider to respond. These timeouts apply only to connections and WebSocket transport.

settings.modelPricingDesc: Prices are stored as currency micros per one million tokens and used for local cost estimates.
settings.themeDesc: Match the system, or pick a fixed appearance.

settings.ccSwitchConfirmBody: Both AIPass and CC Switch manage the same live CLI configs (~/.claude/settings.json and ~/.codex/config.toml). Edits made in one app may conflict with the other. Only enable this if you're comfortable with that.

settings.clipboardClearDesc: Wipe copied secrets after this many seconds.
settings.lockOnSleepDesc: Lock the vault when the system goes to sleep.
settings.lockOnScreenLockDesc: Lock when the OS screen lock activates.
settings.rotateKeysDesc: Re-encrypts all secrets with new keys. Trusted devices need to re-sync afterwards.
settings.icloudDesc: Encrypted sync through your private iCloud database (CloudKit).
